2 IN 1 CAR & HOME DUAL USE - Our electric lunch box / food warmer contains two different plugs: one for work/home (110V) and another one for car/truck (12V).

SAFE FOOD GRADE MATERIAL - The electric bento box is made of food grade plastic and 304 stainless steel container.

FAST HEATING - Adopting PTC energy-saving heating components providing security against overheating.

EASY TO CLEAN - This food heater storage lunch box contains a removable stainless steel tray, which you can clean it easily.

FRIENDLY DESIGN - It has 2 compartments, stop mixing your food! We have included a removable plastic compartment in case you want to separate different types of food.
